basis: Re-derived independently at baseline 740976ecf80a4f2ccdaa611d7790ccaa95b48773 (advisor/ and cmd/slabledger/ are byte-identical to working HEAD bcfa9f33: `git diff --stat 740976ec HEAD -- internal/domain/advisor cmd/slabledger` is empty). (1) NO CALL SITE, INCLUDING IN-PACKAGE: word-boundary search over the whole tree, not just *.go, `git grep -nE '\bWithMaxTokens\b|\bWithTemperature\b'` returns only internal/domain/advisor/service.go:40,41,45,46 (doc comment + declaration for each) plus this audit's own findings/maps files. There are no in-package references either, so LENS-BRIEF trap 1 (in-package caller) does not apply. (2) NOT PASSED AS A VALUE OR ASSEMBLED PROGRAMMATICALLY: I searched the option TYPE rather than the names. `git grep -nE '\bServiceOption\b' -- '*.go'` shows exactly one site that builds an []advisor.ServiceOption, cmd/slabledger/init_services.go:77-90; there is no helper anywhere returning []advisor.ServiceOption and no bare-identifier (parenless) reference to either option. `git grep -nE 'advisor\.With' -- '*.go'` returns five hits, all in init_services.go, and none is WithMaxTokens/WithTemperature. (3) SECOND CLAIM (fields stuck at defaults) CHECKED SEPARATELY AND HOLDS: `git grep -nE '\bmaxTokens\b|\btemperature\b' -- 'internal/domain/advisor/*.go'` enumerates every mention. The only WRITES are service_impl.go:65-66 (constructor defaults defaultMaxTokens/defaultTemperature) and service.go:42,47 (the two dead option bodies). There is no constructor parameter for them (NewService takes only llm, executor, opts...), no config read (config has an AdvisorRefreshConfig but `git grep -nE 'AdvisorRefresh'` shows its only knob is MaxToolRounds, via ADVISOR_MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS; there is no max-tokens or temperature env/flag/field), and no direct field write from outside. The only READS are tool_loop.go:49/54 (temperature) and :55 (maxTokens). So with both options unreachable, s.maxTokens and s.temperature are provably fixed at 32768 and 0.3 for every constructed service, in production and in tests alike (all seven service_test.go NewService calls pass zero options). (4) RUNTIME MECHANISMS: no file under internal/domain/advisor carries a //go:build line, so the integration tag changes nothing (`go vet -tags integration ./internal/domain/advisor/...` clean, and the tag-inclusive grep above was tree-wide). ServiceOption is a concrete func type, so no interface satisfaction or embedding indirection is possible; the fields are unexported and untagged, so serialization cannot reach them; no go:embed, no init(), no reflection or string-keyed dispatch. (5) NOT A NAME COLLISION: the map records at docs/audit/maps/go-reference-map.json for both symbols carry external_refs 0 with no name_ambiguous flag, and every one of my own grep hits is inside internal/domain/advisor/service.go. WHICH FIX IS HONEST: I checked the alternative 'plumbed but never turned on' reading and the evidence points to deletion, not wiring. The defaults are not accidental — service_impl.go:13-18 carries a comment recording an empirical tuning (16384 caused Azure to return 'status incomplete' on the final analysis round for large flagged inventories; 32768 was chosen to fix that). So the defaults are demonstrably RIGHT for production rather than wrong, and no config surface exists that was meant to override them. This is configurability that was exposed and never needed, which makes removal the low-risk call; the finding's own proposed_fix leaves the choice to the fixer, which is a fair framing.
what_the_finding_got_wrong: Nothing material; both claims survive. Two presentational defects worth noting for whoever reads the finding rather than re-running it. (a) The `output` fields of evidence items 3 and 4 are paraphrases, not verbatim command output — item 3 reflows the source and elides an argument as `WithMaxToolRounds(...)`, and item 4 replaces grep output with an English summary. Both COMMANDS reproduce and both substantively say what the finding says they say, so this is not a reproduction failure, but it violates the LENS-BRIEF §4 rule against commentary in evidence fields. (b) Item 4's summary is slightly incomplete: it omits service.go:42 and :47 (the option bodies, which are themselves writes to the fields) and labels tool_loop.go:49 as the temperature read when :49 takes the address into a local that is used at :54. Neither omission changes the conclusion — I enumerated the full write and read sets myself above. One scoping note for the controller, not an error: `blast_radius` lists only internal/domain/advisor/service.go, which is correct for the removal branch but understates the wiring branch, which would also touch internal/platform/config/{types,defaults,loader}.go and cmd/slabledger/init_services.go.
